formal_only|accepted
schema_metadata|accepted
additive|accepted
conditional|schema_lowering_requires_assertion|schema transition requires an explicit data assertion
backfill_required|schema_lowering_requires_backfill|schema transition requires an explicit backfill plan
destructive|schema_lowering_destructive|destructive schema transition requires an identity-bound approval
opaque|schema_lowering_opaque|opaque schema transition requires explicit operator intent
unsupported|schema_lowering_unsupported|schema transition is unsupported by the TypeDB 3.12.1 lowering profile
